title: WISE Digital Partners: Expert Coworking Marketing Services

facts.fact: WISE Digital Partners offers a 15-Minute Consultation at no charge, described as a quick, honest call with no sales pitch.
facts.quote:
15-Minute Consultation

Free

A quick, honest call to assess your needs and point you in the right direction—no sales pitch.

facts.fact: WISE Digital Partners lists its 60-Minute Strategy Session at a price range of $175 to $250.
The 60-Minute Strategy Session includes a $250 digital audit covering the client's website, SEO, local presence, and online performance, which the client keeps.
facts.quote: Includes a $250 digital audit covering your website, SEO, local presence, and online performance—yours to keep.

facts.fact: WISE Digital Partners says the 15-Minute Consultation is best suited for established businesses with a defined marketing budget that are prepared to grow and scale.
facts.quote:
Best suited for:

*   Established businesses with a defined marketing budget
*   Businesses prepared to grow and scale

facts.fact: WISE Digital Partners states that its team reaches out within 3-5 business days after a proposal or application form is submitted, to schedule a call if there is a good fit.
facts.quote: Someone on our team will reach out in 3-5 business days to schedule a call if we see a good fit.
